name: FA Cup
format: Single-leg knockout. League One/Two enter First Round (Nov), PL/Championship enter Third Round (Jan). No replays. Extra time + penalties. Semi-finals and final at Wembley (May).

name: EFL Cup
format: Single-leg knockout from Aug; clubs in UEFA competitions enter Round 3. Straight to penalties after 90 mins before the semis. Two-legged semi-finals; final at Wembley (Mar).

name: EFL Trophy
format: Regional groups of 4 (Aug-Nov), then single-leg knockout; final at Wembley (Apr).

name: Community Shield
format: PL champion v FA Cup winner, one match at Wembley before the season.

name: Coppa Italia
format: Single-leg ties at the higher seed; top 8 seeds from last season's Serie A enter at the Round of 16. Two-legged semi-finals. Final at the Stadio Olimpico, Rome (May).

name: Supercoppa Italiana
format: Four teams (Serie A top two + Coppa Italia finalists): semi-finals and final in Saudi Arabia in early January.

name: Copa del Rey
format: Single-leg ties hosted by the lower-tier club until the semis; Supercopa sides enter later. Two-legged semis; final in April at La Cartuja, Seville.

name: Supercopa de España
format: Four teams (LaLiga top two + Copa finalists) in Saudi Arabia in January.

name: DFB-Pokal
format: 64 teams, single-leg ties; the lower-tier club hosts in early rounds. Final at the Olympiastadion, Berlin (May).

name: DFL-Supercup
format: Bundesliga champion v DFB-Pokal winner, one match in August at the champion's ground.
